summary.key_theme: 受惠於 AI 數據中心對核能電力需求的激增，公司透過簽署長期購電協議 (PPA) 與上調財測，展現強勁的成長動能。

bullish.title: Constellation Energy (CEG) Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript — Nuclear PPAs surge as adjusted operating earnings jump to $2.55 per share.
bullish.reason: 第二季調整後每股盈餘達 2.55 美元，且核能購電協議 (PPA) 需求激增，顯示公司核心業務獲利能力顯著提升。

bullish.title: CEG Q2 Earnings Call Focuses on Higher Guidance and Nuclear Deals — Constellation lifts 2026 earnings guidance as Calpine accretion, nuclear contracting and Crane progress strengthen its g
bullish.reason: 公司上調 2026 年財測，並強調 Calpine 收購案的綜效與核能合約進展，為股價提供強勁支撐。

bullish.title: Constellation Signed 920 Megawatts of New Power Deals, Including a Walmart PPA. Here's What It Means for CEG Stock.
bullish.reason: 成功簽署 920 MW 的新電力合約，包含 Walmart 的購電協議，證明公司在滿足大型企業能源需求方面的市場競爭力。

bullish.title: Constellation Energy's nuclear capacity enables it to grow from AI: Powers Advisory's Matt Powers
bullish.reason: 市場專家指出核能發電能力是 AI 產業成長的關鍵基礎設施，將長期推升 Constellation Energy 的價值。

bullish.title: Constellation Energy: Higher Guidance And Nuclear Scarcity Are Starting To Pay Off
bullish.reason: 核能資源稀缺性與 AI 電力需求結合，加上股票回購計畫，被視為推動 EPS 成長的關鍵驅動力。

bearish.title: Constellation (CEG) Locks In More Power Deals As Nuclear Output Slips
bearish.reason: 儘管合約簽署順利，但核能產出出現小幅下滑，可能對短期營運效率造成微小壓力。

neutral.title: Argus Research Maintains Buy on Constellation Energy, Lowers Price Target to $325
neutral.reason: 維持買進評級但下調目標價至 325 美元，反映分析師對估值調整的謹慎態度，但整體看好趨勢不變。

neutral.title: Constellation Energy Stock: Analyst Estimates & Ratings
neutral.reason: 彙整市場分析師評級與估值，顯示股價過去一年表現落後大盤，但市場對未來成長潛力仍持正面看法。
